all.name: All alerts
all.description: Every unique rule from every supported pack in one installation. Review the selection: overlapping thresholds and frequent state changes can be noisy. Vehicle support and telemetry availability vary.

everyday.name: Everyday essentials
everyday.description: Battery, charging, locks, gear selection, home arrivals and departures, and software reminders for daily ownership.

charging.name: Charging companion
charging.description: Charging starts, stops and completion, port and latch changes, fast-charger connections, schedules and cold-weather preparation.

security.name: Security settings
security.description: Locks, PIN, valet, guest mode, Sentry and window changes. These are not intrusion detection or parked-only rules.

trip.name: Road-trip companion
trip.description: Layered battery reminders, charging, gear selection, navigation changes and weather preparation for longer journeys.

climate.name: Cabin comfort
climate.description: Cabin and outside temperatures, preconditioning, climate power and keeper modes. Not an occupant-safety monitor.

battery.name: Battery watch
battery.description: Layered battery thresholds, charge limits, battery heating, BMS completion and module temperatures.

driving.name: Drive and arrival
driving.description: Gear changes, driver presence and navigation. Individual signals do not prove a journey started or that the vehicle is moving.

locations.name: Places and routines
locations.description: Home, work, saved favorites and destination changes using the vehicle's location flags.

software.name: Software watch
software.description: Update availability, progress, schedules and version changes. A stopped update is not proof of success.

media.name: Soundtrack companion
media.description: Track, artist, station, source and playback changes. May be chatty; review cooldowns before enabling.

powershare.name: Powershare watch
powershare.description: Power-sharing state, type and stop reasons, with battery-reserve reminders. Requires a vehicle that supports Powershare.

winter.name: Cold-weather readiness
winter.description: Cold cabin and battery, preconditioning, heating and charge-port cold-weather mode. Not a road-ice or occupant-safety detector.

handover.name: Shared vehicle handover
handover.description: Lock, PIN, valet, guest mode and driver-presence changes. Review access settings yourself; no commands are issued.

custom.name: Custom pack
custom.description: Choose supported rules to build your own group.

battery-reserve.name: Battery reserve below 30%
battery-reserve.message: {{VehicleName}} has {{Value}}% remaining. A good moment to plan the next plug-in.

battery-full.name: Battery above 90%
battery-full.message: {{VehicleName}} has reached {{Value}}%. Plenty in the battery for the next chapter.

battery-heating.name: Battery heater active
battery-heating.message: {{VehicleName}} is warming its battery. Cold-weather preparation is underway.

battery-heating-ended.name: Battery heater stopped
battery-heating-ended.message: {{VehicleName}} reports its battery heater has stopped.

bms-full.name: BMS full charge complete
bms-full.message: {{VehicleName}} reports its battery-management full-charge cycle complete.

module-hot.name: Battery module temperature high

module-cold.name: Battery module temperature low
module-cold.message: {{VehicleName}} has a cold battery module. Charging and regeneration may be limited.

charge-port-open.name: Charge port opened
charge-port-open.message: {{VehicleName}} has opened its charge port. Ready for a connection.

fast-charger.name: Fast charger connected
fast-charger.message: {{VehicleName}} has detected a fast charger. Watch the charging session for actual power.

fast-charger-left.name: Fast charger disconnected
fast-charger-left.message: {{VehicleName}} no longer detects a fast charger.

charge-scheduled.name: Scheduled charging pending

charge-schedule-mode.name: Charging schedule changed
charge-schedule-mode.message: {{VehicleName}} has a new charging schedule mode: {{Value}}.

locked.name: Vehicle locked
locked.message: {{VehicleName}} reports locked. One less thing to double-check.

valet-disabled.name: Valet mode disabled
valet-disabled.message: {{VehicleName}} reports Valet Mode disabled. Review access settings when keys change hands.

sentry-state.name: Sentry mode changed
sentry-state.message: {{VehicleName}} changed Sentry Mode to {{Value}}. A mode change is not evidence of an intrusion.

window-rear-driver.name: Rear driver window changed
window-rear-driver.message: {{VehicleName}} reports the rear driver window is {{Value}}.

drive-started.name: Drive gear selected
drive-started.message: {{VehicleName}} has selected drive. The next chapter is ahead.

drive-parked.name: Park gear selected
drive-parked.message: {{VehicleName}} has selected park. Take a breath before the next trip.

drive-reverse.name: Reverse gear selected
drive-reverse.message: {{VehicleName}} has selected Reverse. A small step back before moving on.

driver-belt.name: Driver seatbelt changed
driver-belt.message: {{VehicleName}} reports driver seatbelt state {{Value}}. This does not establish whether the vehicle is moving.

home-arrived.name: Arrived home
home-arrived.message: {{VehicleName}} reports home. The familiar end of a journey.

home-left.name: Left home
home-left.message: {{VehicleName}} no longer reports being at home.

work-left.name: Left work
work-left.message: {{VehicleName}} no longer reports being at work.

favorite-arrived.name: Arrived at a favorite location
favorite-arrived.message: {{VehicleName}} reports arrival at a saved favorite.

favorite-left.name: Left a favorite location
favorite-left.message: {{VehicleName}} no longer reports being at a saved favorite.

hvac-on.name: Climate system active
hvac-on.message: {{VehicleName}} has switched climate on. Comfort is getting some attention.

climate-keeper.name: Climate keeper mode changed
climate-keeper.message: {{VehicleName}} reports climate keeper mode {{Value}}. Never use this notification as an occupant-safety monitor.

climate-auto.name: Automatic climate mode changed
climate-auto.message: {{VehicleName}} has changed automatic climate mode to {{Value}}.

outside-hot.name: Outside temperature high
outside-hot.message: {{VehicleName}} reports hot weather outside. Plan cabin comfort before departure.

outside-freezing.name: Outside temperature below freezing
outside-freezing.message: {{VehicleName}} reports freezing air outside. This does not measure road conditions.

update-available.name: Software update available
update-available.message: {{VehicleName}} has a software update available. A new chapter is waiting.

update-started.name: Software update in progress
update-started.message: {{VehicleName}} is updating its software. Leave the update to finish.

update-ended.name: Software update no longer in progress
update-ended.message: {{VehicleName}} no longer reports an update in progress. Check the vehicle for the outcome.

powershare-stop.name: Powershare stop reason changed
powershare-stop.message: {{VehicleName}} reports Powershare stop reason {{Value}}. Review the vehicle for context.

battery-low.name: Battery running low
battery-low.message: {{VehicleName}} is down to {{Value}}% battery. Time to put the next charge on the map.

battery-critical.name: Battery critically low
battery-critical.message: {{VehicleName}} has {{Value}}% battery remaining. Plan a safe charging stop.

charge-complete.name: Charging complete
charge-complete.message: {{VehicleName}} has finished its charging chapter. Next stop: your choice.

charge-started.name: Charging started
charge-started.message: {{VehicleName}} is taking an electricity break. Charging has started.

charge-stopped.name: Charging stopped
charge-stopped.message: {{VehicleName}} reports charging stopped. If that was not planned, check the session.

unlocked.name: Vehicle unlocked
unlocked.message: {{VehicleName}} reports unlocked. A useful heads-up if you expected it to be locked.

pin-disabled.name: PIN to drive disabled
pin-disabled.message: {{VehicleName}} reports PIN to drive disabled. Check this setting if the change was unexpected.

valet-enabled.name: Valet mode enabled
valet-enabled.message: {{VehicleName}} reports Valet Mode enabled. The keys may be shared, but the settings are worth a glance.

cabin-hot.name: Cabin temperature high
cabin-hot.message: {{VehicleName}} reports a hot cabin. Check cabin conditions before getting in; never rely on this alert for occupant safety.

cabin-cold.name: Cabin below freezing
cabin-cold.message: {{VehicleName}} has a frosty cabin. Consider preconditioning before your next departure.

software-version.name: Software version changed
software-version.message: {{VehicleName}} has a new software chapter: {{Value}}. Take a look at the release notes.

preconditioning.name: Preconditioning active
preconditioning.message: {{VehicleName}} is getting ready: preconditioning is active.

charge-limit.name: Charge limit changed
charge-limit.message: {{VehicleName}} has a new charging target: {{Value}}%. Check that it suits your next journey.

aiBaseline.title: Learn per-vehicle baseline

aiExplanation.emptyHint: Select a vehicle above to explain its anomalies.

browserNotifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked. Enable in your browser settings.

aiAgent.departureAssumption: No departure was supplied. This standalone draft assumes departure at the current time.
aiAgent.description: Ask Helix to propose a time-of-use-optimized charge schedule grounded in your selected rate plan and target departure. The schedule is never saved automatically — review the proposed window and click Schedule below to apply it.
aiAgent.emptyHint: Select a vehicle and a rate plan to draft a schedule.
aiAgent.title: Draft a schedule with Helix

chargePlanner.invalidDepartBy: Enter a valid departure date and time.

aiClustering.emptyHint: Select a vehicle to explain its charging-curve clusters.
aiClustering.independentDescription: Ask Helix to name and explain cluster fingerprints from retrieved charging history and a separate per-vehicle feature-query tool. That tool uses its own lookback window (90 days by default), not the workspace date range; retrieved history is not limited to the chart window. The narrator does not change cluster bucketing, and its source data is not established as equivalent to the charts below.
aiClustering.title: Explain the charging-curve cluster fingerprints

aiMlClustering.independentDescription: Compute a learned charging envelope for the selected vehicle over an independent 90-day window. Helix narrates the training and cluster-query tool results, including rule-label fallbacks when data is insufficient. The workspace date range does not filter this request; these results are not established as equivalent to the charts below and do not replace them.
aiMlClustering.noVehicleHint: Pick a vehicle to train its charging-curve clusters.
aiMlClustering.title: Learn per-vehicle charging-curve clusters

aiDiagnosis.description: Get a 2-4 paragraph plain-language explanation of any flags raised on this charging session — trickle, expensive, low-power, or interrupted — generated from the same deterministic aggregation metrics shown above.
aiDiagnosis.title: Charging diagnosis

aiPreheatPrecool.description: Ask Helix to draft an advisory preheat or precool window using the departure heuristic and current temperatures. Helix does not save or apply a schedule. Review the proposal, then use the Vehicle command center for manual climate actions. Its Add precondition action uses a fixed 7 AM daily schedule, not the proposed window.
aiPreheatPrecool.emptyHint: Select a vehicle and confirm the cabin temperature, outside temperature, and departure time to draft a schedule.
aiPreheatPrecool.title: Suggest a preheat or precool schedule

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain the deterministic period-over-period analytics — which one or two metrics moved most between Period A and Period B, with directional phrasing keyed to the percent_change sign. The numbers are the same the chart and table below show; the narrator only explains them and is honest about zero-baseline windows and best-effort cost figures.
aiNarrative.noVehicleHint: Pick a vehicle to enable Helix narration.
aiNarrative.title: Narrate the period comparison

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain the deterministic charging-cost forecast — the historical trend, the projected cost / cost_low / cost_high band, the home-vs-supercharger split, and the deterministic insight. The dollar amounts are the same the chart below shows; the narrator only explains them and is honest that the band is an APPROXIMATE prediction interval, not a strict 95% confidence interval.
aiNarrative.title: Narrate the charging-cost forecast

aiSuggestions.description: Propose a typed repair plan (close, quarantine, or partial-update) for one stale charging session or drive from the inventory below. Helix never writes; review the proposal and use the matching baseline form to apply it.
aiSuggestions.title: Helix repair suggestions

byteRate.description: Recorded bytes per second; the displayed interval is explicit.

avgDuration.description: Existing average session duration calculation, expressed in canonical seconds.

energyAdded.description: Recorded energy added on included charging sessions.
energyAdded.label: Energy added

meanSessionPower.description: Arithmetic mean of finite session average powers; not peak power.
meanSessionPower.label: Mean session power

overallRate.description: Aggregate valid energy divided by corresponding positive duration; not mean session power.
overallRate.label: Overall charging rate

peakPower.description: Highest observed charging power; never a replacement for an average.
peakPower.label: Peak power

recordedCost.description: Recorded session costs, not tariff estimates or billing.
recordedCost.label: Recorded cost

sessions.description: Number of returned charging sessions included by the existing filter.
sessions.label: Sessions

count.description: Declared count, not inferred from an integer measurement.
count.label: Count

currency.description: Amount in its recorded denomination; no currency conversion.
currency.label: Cost

distance.description: Measured distance; canonical input is meters.
distance.label: Distance

duration.description: Elapsed duration; canonical input is seconds.
duration.label: Duration

efficiency.description: Consumption in watt-hours per meter; not reciprocal economy.
efficiency.label: Energy intensity

energy.description: Measured energy; canonical input is watt-hours.
energy.label: Energy

identifier.description: Source identifier, retained without grouping or rounding.
identifier.label: Identifier

latency.description: Recorded non-negative elapsed time in seconds, displayed in milliseconds or seconds.
latency.label: Latency

number.description: Unclassified numeric quantity; semantic meaning remains unknown.
number.label: Value

percent.description: Percentage input is already on the 0–100 scale.
percent.label: Percentage

power.description: Measured power; canonical input is watts.
power.label: Power

rate.description: Source-defined rate; the caller declares the quantity and time unit.
rate.label: Rate

score.description: Numeric score on a declared 100-point scale.
score.label: Score

fitStatus.description: Existing translated fit status; no invented eligibility threshold.
fitStatus.label: Fit status

inSampleRSquared.description: Existing dimensionless in-sample coefficient, not a percent.
inSampleRSquared.label: In-sample R²

includedDrives.description: Drive count admitted by the existing seasonal eligibility rules.
includedDrives.label: Included drives

observedIntensity.description: Existing observed consumption over included drives.
observedIntensity.label: Observed energy intensity

speed.description: Measured speed; canonical input is meters per second.
speed.label: Speed

status.description: Source-provided status, retained without numeric coercion.
status.label: Status

temperature.description: Absolute temperature in degrees Celsius; not a temperature difference.
temperature.label: Temperature

text.description: Source-provided text, retained without numeric coercion.
text.label: Text

aiCoaching.description: Get a 2-4 paragraph plain-language coaching summary of this drive — efficiency, regen use, and notable braking or acceleration moments — generated from the same per-drive metrics shown above.

alertFatigue.fatiguing: The noise score blends three things that make a rule tiring rather than helpful: how many times a day it fires, what share of those firings arrive in bursts on the heels of another, and how often a delivered notification is never read. A rule can be low-volume and still fatiguing if every firing comes in a cluster of six.

alertStudio.alertBehavior: Pick 'Notify on event' for one-time confirmations like 'vehicle locked' or 'charging done'. Pick 'Re-alert until resolved' for ongoing safety concerns like 'vehicle unlocked' or 'door open'.
alertStudio.cooldown: Minimum minutes between repeat firings of this rule. Prevents the same condition from spamming your channels (e.g. battery at 19% triggering once per minute).
alertStudio.kind: Signal threshold compares live telemetry; computed metric aggregates over a time window. System service watches outage or recovery for the whole fleet. Place event watches arrival or departure from a saved place.
alertStudio.operator: Comparison applied to the signal value: =, !=, <, <=, >, >=, between, any change. Some operators only apply to numeric signals.
alertStudio.severity: Visual / routing priority — info, warn, or critical. Channels can subscribe to specific severities to keep critical alerts from being drowned out by chatty info ones.

channels.botToken: Telegram BotFather token in the format `<id>:<secret>`. Create a bot via @BotFather on Telegram, then start a chat with it before TeslaSync can deliver.
channels.chatId: Numeric Telegram chat ID. For a private bot chat this is your user ID; for a group it's negative (e.g. -1001234567890).
channels.configSection: Provider-specific credentials and routing details. Required fields vary by channel type. All secrets are encrypted at rest.
channels.method: HTTP method TeslaSync uses for outbound delivery. POST is universal; some receivers require PUT or PATCH.
channels.nameLabel: Friendly identifier shown in the channel list and on alert delivery logs. Has no functional impact — pick anything memorable.
channels.ntfyServer: Base URL of the ntfy server (e.g. https://ntfy.sh for the public server, or your self-hosted instance).
channels.ntfyTopic: Topic name on the ntfy server. Anyone with the topic name can subscribe — pick something hard to guess for sensitive alerts.
channels.smtpHost: Mail server hostname (e.g. smtp.gmail.com). Most providers use port 587 with STARTTLS; check your provider's docs for the right host + port pair.
channels.smtpPassword: SMTP password or app-specific password. Stored encrypted at rest. Many providers (Gmail, Microsoft 365) require an app password rather than your account password.
channels.smtpPort: SMTP server port. 587 for STARTTLS (recommended), 465 for implicit TLS, 25 for plain (insecure — only on local relays).
channels.testHint: Use the "Send Test" button after saving to verify your configuration. Tests bypass severity filters but otherwise match real delivery.
channels.webhookUrl: Full HTTPS URL TeslaSync POSTs the JSON body to. Discord and Slack provide their own webhook endpoints; for custom services use the generic Webhook channel.

aiNarration.description: Ask Helix to explain the deterministic operating-cost evidence below. Lifetime equivalent gas cost is derived from positive-drive distance, configured gas price per unit, and comparison MPG; only monthly equivalent gas rows estimate distance from recorded-cost charging energy. The layer also discloses the positive-cost charging filter, the flat $50-per-modeled-month maintenance heuristic, and the excluded ownership costs.
